subject: Request: Short-term retention waiver for incident debug snapshots
messages:
From: Alice Mullen <alice.mullen@acme-corp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme-corp.com
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short outage / logs request

Hi Rishi,

We saw a brief degradation in our integration with your inference endpoint on 2025-09-14 between 02:23–02:37 UTC. Our devs captured a set of client-side traces and a partial snapshot from our side, but we need a short server-side KV/cache+request trace to correlate the missing tokens.

Can Redwood keep the relevant request traces and the KV cache snapshot for that 2025-09-14 02:20–02:40 UTC window for up to 72 hours while we debug? We know this is outside the normal retention window for ephemeral debug traces. If you need, I've attached our internal debug summary (acme_debug_summary.txt) and the signed waiver form from our security team.

Attachment: acme_debug_summary.txt (1.1KB)
Attachment: waiver_request_form_20250915.pdf (PDF, 42KB)

Appreciate a confirmation and any guidance on what you need from us to proceed.

Thanks,
Alice Mullen
Senior Platform Engineer, Acme Corp
security@acme-corp.com

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Sep 2025 17:04:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Re: Short outage / logs request -- need retention waiver?

Folks — forwarding a request from Acme. They want us to preserve server-side request traces + KV cache snapshot for ~72 hours to correlate a production tokenization/regression issue. They included a waiver PDF from their security team.

Questions / ask:
- Legal / security: do we have a standard temporary-retention waiver process? Any mandatory anonymization steps before we share?
- Ops: can we take a diagnostic snapshot (non-prod copy) of the request traces / KV cache for the time window and place it in a gated bucket for 72 hours? Note this is time-sensitive — they want the window preserved ASAP.

Proposed immediate action: I can open INF-2107 and gate the snapshot with read-only ACL to the security@acme-corp.com address and add a short access log. If legal needs a doc-signed exception, we should do that first.

I won't preserve anything until we confirm the process. Tagging Monica for ops execution and Hannah/Markus for legal/security sign-off.

Thanks,
Rishi
Support Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 16 Sep 2025 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Re: Short outage / logs request -- need retention waiver?

Rishi / team — I've reviewed Acme's waiver and the risk surface. We can approve a time-limited retention waiver under the following conditions: 

1) Scope: preserve only server request metadata, per-token latency logs, and the KV-cache snapshot for the 2025-09-14 02:20–02:40 UTC window. No full user prompt bodies should be exported unless redacted.
2) Minimization: redact or hash any user-identifying fields before export.
3) Access window: 72 hours maximum from confirmation time.
4) Audit: create a Jira ticket (INF-2107) and record timestamped access logs; security must be CC'd on any download.
5) Ownership: Acme must sign the waiver (we have their PDF, but Legal needs a countersignature unless an approved privacy policy covers this).

If Ops can stage the snapshot into a locked S3 bucket with explicit ACLs and we can add automated deletion after 72 hours, proceed. Hannah, can you confirm the minimal redaction script we should apply? Monica, schedule the snapshot and post the bucket link to INF-2107.

-Markus
Head of Legal, Redwood Inference

On Mon, 15 Sep 2025 at 17:04 Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Folks — forwarding a request from Acme...
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Mullen <alice.mullen@acme-corp.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, security@acme-corp.com
Date: Wed, 17 Sep 2025 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Short outage / logs request -- retention waiver approved (INF-2107)

Hi Alice — thanks for the waiver and the details. Key updates below:

- Legal has approved a short-term retention waiver subject to redaction and countersignature (see INF-2107).
- Ops has staged a diagnostic snapshot in a locked bucket: s3://redwood-debug/INF-2107/acme_snapshot_20250914.tar.gz (read access granted only to security@acme-corp.com).
- Files preserved: per-request metadata, token timing traces, KV cache dump (metadata-only fields). No raw prompt bodies were exported — sensitive fields have been hashed.
- Access window: snapshot will be available for 72 hours from 2025-09-17T09:05:00-07:00 and will be auto-deleted at 2025-09-20T09:05:00-07:00. Audit logs will be published to the Jira ticket.

Attachments: acme_debug_snapshot_20250914.tar.gz (attachment stub)

Next steps for Acme: please confirm the accounts that will access the bucket and whether you need a short Zoom with our ops engineer to walk through the data. Also reply with a countersignature if you haven't sent one; we'll countersign on our side as well.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Support Manager, Redwood Inference
